description: Deep-tech research platform with application-layer PQC integration, quantum/classical simulations, AI infrastructure experiments, smart-contract artifacts and internal verification gates.

technicalLayers.name: Deterministic crypto-path checks
technicalLayers.description: Selected cryptographic paths are checked for deterministic/CSPRNG-safe behavior.

technicalLayers.name: ML-KEM-768 integration
technicalLayers.description: FIPS 203 algorithm integration/wire properties are tested; the application is not FIPS validated.

technicalLayers.name: ML-DSA-65 integration
technicalLayers.description: FIPS 204 algorithm integration/sign-verify properties are tested; the application is not FIPS validated.

technicalLayers.name: Adversarial/tamper regression tests
technicalLayers.description: Repository-defined tamper/negative cases are exercised; no independent penetration-test certification is implied.

technicalLayers.name: EVM/BNB contract research
technicalLayers.description: Contract source/artifact exists for BNB/EVM targeting; live mainnet deployment is not asserted.

technicalLayers.name: Company OS policy research
technicalLayers.description: Policy/orchestration modules are tested; production autonomy and enterprise controls require external deployment validation.

technicalLayers.name: Internal evidence gates
technicalLayers.description: Repository-defined verification gates and scorecards are regression artifacts, not independent certification.

internalGates.name: URS v2.0 internal repository gates
internalGates.note: A 12/12 internal gate pass indicates the repository-defined checks passed on that commit only.
